record.name: Mission Bay South Block 18C (UCSF Child Development Center)
names: UCSF at Mission Bay Child Development Center
record.summary: UCSF's June 2025 presentation to the Mission Bay Citizens Advisory Committee lists Block 18C among its undeveloped parcels remaining, with open space as the long-term use and a childcare center as the near-term use. That matches this record's status of existing, not yet redeveloped: a childcare center operates on the block now, on ground UCSF still counts as undeveloped. Bright Horizons lists the UCSF at Mission Bay Child Development Center at 727 Nelson Rising Lane, a city business registration and the city's address point for that address place it here.

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE BOUNDARY -- traced as the leftover open ground between the mapped street lines and neighbouring mapped shapes, rather than from a specific real parcel or building-footprint source; the pieces making up this shape were chosen and combined by hand. The small smoothing step used to bridge two internal walkway gaps may slightly overstate area at those two seams. IDENTITY: this shape is identified as the UCSF at Mission Bay Child Development Center by four sources together: (1) Bright Horizons' own centre page names 'UCSF at Mission Bay Child Development Center' at 727 Nelson Rising Lane; (2) DataSF Registered Business Locations lists 'Ucsf Child Care At Mission Bay', owned by Bright Horizons, at 727 Nelson Rising Ln (certificate 0941054); (3) the City's address point for 727 Nelson Rising Ln (DataSF Addresses, address ID 743045, at -122.39330278, 37.76944026) falls inside this shape, about 2.7 m from its edge, and the nearest other mapped shape (Block 15B) is about 20 m away; (4) UCSF's June 2025 CAC presentation gives Block 18C's near-term use as 'Childcare Center'. Limits: the address point is a frontage point, not a building footprint, so it places the centre in this block, not this exact outline; 727 Nelson Rising Ln also carries other business registrations (a UCSF shuttle fuelling business), so the address is not exclusive to this building; and no source gives an opening date (the business registration's 2024-01-01 location start is a registration date, not an opening). Marked 'existing' rather than 'complete' because the UCSF map treats this as an interim use ahead of a long-term 'Open Space' redesignation, not a finished build-out.
notes.digitized_from: Real block boundary built from mapped street centerlines (trimmed against the full street width).

Bright Horizons' own page and the City's business registrations place the centre at that address, the City's address point for 727 Nelson Rising Lane falls inside this shape (about 2.7 m from its edge; the nearest other mapped block is about 20 m away), and UCSF's June 2025 presentation gives the block's near-term use as a childcare center. The address point marks the street frontage, not the building, and the address also carries another business registration, so it is not exclusive to this building. No source gives an opening date. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address now redirects to the new one.

open_questions: Is a childcare building standing on Block 18C today? A childcare center is registered and addressed here, and UCSF names a childcare center as 18C's near-term use while still counting the block as undeveloped, but no source read gives the building's footprint or says when it was built or opened.
'Operating since 2006' (in the geometry file notes) was not found on either Bright Horizons page read; no opening or construction date for the center was found.

OCII's December 2019 Land Use Map text shows plan blocks 18A and 18B on this row and no 18C; the block number comes from UCSF's own list. How UCSF's 18C relates to OCII's plan blocks was not resolved from text.
No developer, architect, owner of the building or cost was found.

record.notes: Sited immediately west of Sandler Neurosciences Center. Per UCSF's own Dec 2024-updated campus map (June 2025 CAC presentation), this is Block 18C, long-term planned as Open Space, with a childcare center as its near-term use. Operated by Bright Horizons as the UCSF at Mission Bay Child Development Center, 727 Nelson Rising Lane (Bright Horizons centre page; DataSF Registered Business Locations); see About this shape for how the address is tied to this shape. No opening date is sourced.
